entities.name: Gato Pérez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Xavier Patricio Pérez Álvarez, known as Gato Pérez, was a musician of Argentine origin who settled in Catalonia. He stood out in the Catalan rumba musical genre, which he merged with salsa and an original style. He was a singer, composer, and bass guitarist.
